'''Jetboarding''' was a leisure activity practiced on [[Jerrilek]].<ref name="Journal4">{{JournalCite|4|Loyalties}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Jetboarding first appeared in "[[Loyalties]]," a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure written by [[James L. Cambias]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' and published in the [[November]] [[1994]] [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 4|fourth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' magazine.<ref name="Journal4" />
